title: Config-flow device pre-fill page renders window errors with an unfilled {min_window_minutes} placeholder
claim: When the setup wizard's device_prefill page refuses a DHW or silent-mode window shorter than 15 min, the form result carries no min_window_minutes placeholder, so the error string in all 4 language files is rendered with an unfilled {min_window_minutes} (8 field-language pairs), while the options flow's modbus_prefill page, the config dhw page and the options hot_water page supply it (0).
mechanism: HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow._device_prefill_form passes description_placeholders={**device_prefill.disclaimer(), **notes}; the options twin _prefill_form adds **_WINDOW_PLACEHOLDERS. _prefill_errors (shared) can return dhw_window_too_short / silent_mode_window_too_short, whose strings read {min_window_minutes}.

evidence.contention_note: box shared with other seats, load1 ~75; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: mock.patch.object HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow._device_prefill_form to merge config_flow._WINDOW_PLACEHOLDERS into the placeholders (the options page's own rule)

metric_definition: Sum over triggered error cells and language files of {name} placeholders in the returned error's string that result['description_placeholders'] lacks.
phenomenon_property: Every flow form result supplies every placeholder named by its step strings and by the strings of every error key it returns, in every language.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub ~/.local/state/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s2/flow_errors.py (error cells) and PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub ~/.local/state/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s2/flow_pages.py (DESC_UNFILLED, untouched renders)

null_control.note: control cells options.modbus_prefill x2, config.dhw, options.hot_water, options.grid_fees x3 fire the same or sibling errors and leave 0 unfilled

reproduction_steps: Run the command; read CELL config.device_prefill lines: unfilled=4 each
proposed_fix_scope: Add _WINDOW_PLACEHOLDERS to HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow._device_prefill_form's description_placeholders, or share one placeholder builder between the config and options pre-fill forms; add the placeholder-supplied check to tests over every error key a step can return.
